mentions.name: Streamish
mentions.description: A music server compatible with multiple third-party mobile apps, particularly targeting Synology and QNAP setups, with Plex support planned next. Built with NestJS, Sequelize + SQLite, OpenAPI, and Jest on the backend, and React, TanStack, Shadcn, and Playwright on the frontend.
mentions.source_excerpt: Getting https://streamish.github.io/ ready to launch, a music server compatible with multiple 3rd party mobile apps and particularly Synology and QNAP.
